netbios_name.description: NetBIOS name of the server as seen by Windows clients.

workgroup.description: Windows workgroup or domain name. Must match the clients’ workgroup for unauthenticated access.

smb_ports.description: TCP ports to listen on for SMB traffic. Typically [445].

server_signing.description: Enable SMB packet signing for integrity and anti-replay protection. Options: 'yes', 'no', 'auto'.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 (none) to 10 (debug). Higher values increase I/O and log size.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file. Set to empty string to disable logging to file (logs only to syslog).

time_server.description: If enabled, act as an SMB time server for clients to sync clocks.

unix_extensions.description: Enable SMB Unix extensions for POSIX semantics (required for Linux/macOS clients).

winbind_domain.description: Active Directory domain name to integrate with via winbind (optional).

winbind_separator.description: Character used to separate domain and username in winbind lookups (e.g., 'DOMAIN+user').

winbind_enum_users.description: Allow winbind to enumerate users for this server (discovery). May affect performance.

winbind_enum_groups.description: Allow winbind to enumerate groups for this server (discovery). May affect performance.

default_file_permission.description: Octal permission mask applied to new files (if inherit_permissions=false).

default_directory_permission.description: Octal permission mask applied to new directories (if inherit_permissions=false).

inherit_permissions.description: If enabled, new files/dirs inherit parent directory's permissions.

inherit_owner.description: If enabled, new files/dirs inherit parent directory’s ownership (owner and group).

client_idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout in milliseconds before disconnecting inactive clients (0 = disabled).

shares.description: List of shares to expose. Each share defines a directory and access rules.

name.description: Share name (e.g., 'shared', 'public'). Must be unique and not contain spaces/special chars.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory to share.

read_only.description: If true, users can only read files; otherwise, write access is allowed (subject to permissions).

comment.description: Optional human-readable description shown in client browse lists.

write_list.description: Subset of users/groups allowed to write, even in read-only shares.

force_user.description: Force all file operations to run as this system user.

force_group.description: Force all file operations to run as this system group.

create_mask.description: Octal mask applied to new files (overrides default_file_permission for this share).

directory_mask.description: Octal mask applied to new directories (overrides default_directory_permission for this share).

browsable.description: If true, the share appears in browse lists (e.g., 'net view').

printable.description: If true, the share acts as a printer queue (not typical for file shares).

hide_files.description: Glob patterns of files/dirs to hide in the share (e.g., ['.hidden*', '*.tmp']).
